# openwrt_uhttpd_cert (Resource)

Parameters for uhttpd's self-signed certificate (`config cert`).

Manages a `cert` section in `/etc/config/uhttpd`. This section normally exists on a stock router: creating the resource adopts it (renaming an anonymous section to `section`), and destroying the resource only removes it from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `bits` (Number) RSA key size. (UCI option `bits`.)
- `commonname` (String) Common name. (UCI option `commonname`.)
- `country` (String) Country. (UCI option `country`.)
- `days` (Number) Validity in days. (UCI option `days`.)
- `ec_curve` (String) EC curve. (UCI option `ec_curve`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `key_type` (String) Key type. (UCI option `key_type`.) One of: `rsa`, `ec`.
- `location` (String) Location. (UCI option `location`.)
- `organization` (String) Organization. (UCI option `organization`.)
- `state` (String) State. (UCI option `state`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
